# Ten years of opt-out collective actions in the UK


- Antitrust & competition


October 16, 2025


**Craig Arnott & Charlie Rooke**


## Summary


Ten years after the UK’s landmark collective actions reform, the opt-out regime has matured from a theoretical experiment into a powerful mechanism for delivering accountability against corporate misconduct.
